item.title: Newcastle draw 2-2 with Liverpool as former hero Keegan hailed
item.description: Liverpool snatched a dramatic 2-2 draw with Newcastle United at St James' Park on Sunday as Dominik Szoboszlai converted a stoppage-time penalty on a day when both sets of fans united to honour their shared hero Kevin Keegan, who died aged 75 in July.
item.dc:creator: Philip O'connor
item.content:encoded: Liverpool snatched a dramatic 2-2 draw with Newcastle United at St James' Park on Sunday as Dominik Szoboszlai converted a stoppage-time penalty on a day when both sets of fans united to honour their shared hero Kevin Keegan, who died aged 75 in July. As so often when the two sides met during Keegan's managerial career at Newcastle, there was a crucial late goal, with the Hungary international blasting his spot-kick into the top corner to steal a point that looked to have slipped away from the visitors. Anthony Elanga had given Newcastle a dream start to the season, scoring in the fifth minute before Cody Gakpo levelled for Liverpool early in the second half. Joe Willock came off the bench to score what looked likely to be the winner for Newcastle, but deep into stoppage time, Newcastle defender Lewis Hall barged into Liverpool substitute Victor Munoz, and Szoboszlai fired home. Keegan was an important part of the history of both clubs, first with his goal-scoring exploits as a striker on Merseyside before his spells as a player and manager that brought Newcastle back to the top echelons of English football. As a coach on Tyneside he was famed for his all-out attacking approach and hair-raising defending, and the VIP seats were filled with former Newcastle forwards who had come to pay tribute, as did Liverpool icon Kenny Dalglish, who replaced Keegan when the latter left Liverpool for Hamburg in 1977. Former England internationals and Newcastle forwards Alan Shearer, Les Ferdinand and Peter Beardsley were all present, as was mercurial Colombian Faustino Asprilla, sporting a bucket hat in the club’s colours. Elanga quickly gave the former Newcastle heroes something to cheer about when he crowned an incisive counter-attack that ended up with him flashing a shot into the far corner. Gakpo levelled 10 minutes after the break, picking up the ball outside the box and advancing before drilling a shot into the same corner that Elanga chose for the opener, and Newcastle's defending for that goal bore more than a passing resemblance to some of Keegan's leakier rearguards. Willock’s attacking industry was rewarded when he came off the bench and scored almost immediately to restore Newcastle’s lead with a curling, bouncing shot that should have been the winner, but for Hall's clumsy challenge on Munoz. Many expected Alexander Isak, who was roundly booed and jeered on his return to Newcastle after forcing a move to Anfield almost a year ago, to take the spot kick for the Reds, but instead it was Szoboszlai who took control. Despite being more grit than glitter, the game was a fitting tribute to the naturally dramatic Keegan, and the fans of both sides sang his name throughout as his former teams played their parts in a compelling spectacle worthy of his memory.

item.title: Alibaba lança oferta de ações de US$10 bi em Hong Kong para financiar gastos com IA
item.description: A chinesa Alibaba da China lançou neste domingo uma oferta de ações no valor de 80 bilhões de dólares de Hong Kong (US$ 10,2 bilhões) para financiar o desenvolvimento relacionado à inteligência artificial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A chinesa Alibaba da China (9988.HK) lançou neste domingo uma oferta de ações no valor de 80 bilhões de dólares de Hong Kong (US$ 10,2 bilhões) para financiar o desenvolvimento relacionado à inteligência artificial. A operação realizada pela gigante chinesa do comércio eletrônico e da computação em nuvem representaria a maior oferta subsequente primária já realizada por uma empresa listada na bolsa de Hong Kong. Seria a terceira maior oferta subsequente primária de ações deste ano no mundo, atrás apenas das ofertas da Alphabet (GOOGL.O) e da Intel (INTC.O) . A empresa afirmou que pretende usar 100% dos recursos líquidos da colocação para investir em seus recursos de IA “full stack”, uma categoria que inclui chips, infraestrutura e o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos de IA. Um termo de compromisso analisado pela Reuters mostrou que a Alibaba planejava vender 710 milhões de ações ordinárias a HK$ 112,70 por ação. Isso representava um desconto de 3,6% em relação ao seu preço de fechamento mais recente. A empresa não fez comentários além de sua divulgação regulatória. Na semana passada, a Alibaba divulgou seus resultados do trimestre de abril a junho, informando que já havia gasto quase metade de seu plano de investimento em capital de três anos. A empresa afirmou que o retorno esperado dos investimentos relacionados à IA estava a caminho de cair de 3 para 2,5 anos, impulsionado pelo aumento da demanda. O lucro líquido da Alibaba no trimestre caiu 75% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior, à medida que a empresa intensificou seus gastos de capital relacionados à IA. “Para podermos capturar esse crescimento futuro, precisamos primeiro fazer esses investimentos em capex para construir a capacidade computacional necessária”, disse o presidente-executivo Eddie Wu durante uma teleconferência sobre os resultados.

item.title: Health of Norway's king deteriorates while in hospital, palace says
item.description: The health of Norway's King Harald, 89, has deteriorated during the weekend while in hospital, the royal household said in a statement on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The health of Norway's King Harald, 89, has deteriorated during the weekend while in hospital, the royal household said in a statement on Sunday. Harald, Europe's oldest current head of state, was hospitalised on Monday and was treated for anaemia. "His Majesty the King's health deteriorated over the weekend. The King is receiving antibiotics for a bacterial infection in his blood, and has responded to this treatment," the palace said, while adding that his condition was stable.

item.title: Partido alemão AfD aposta em vitória na Saxônia-Anhalt como primeiro passo rumo ao poder federal
item.description: O partido de extrema direita alemão Alternativa para a Alemanha (AfD) aposta em um avanço nas eleições estaduais do próximo mês para ganhar impulso rumo a uma futura vitória nacional, afirmou a co-líder do partido, Alice Weidel, neste domingo .
item.dc:creator: Maria Martinez
item.content:encoded: O partido de extrema direita alemão Alternativa para a Alemanha (AfD) aposta em um avanço nas eleições estaduais do próximo mês para ganhar impulso rumo a uma futura vitória nacional, afirmou a co-líder do partido, Alice Weidel, neste domingo . “Formaremos o governo na Saxônia-Anhalt”, disse Weidel em entrevista à emissora pública ZDF, referindo-se ao Estado do leste da Alemanha onde as eleições ocorrerão em 6 de setembro. Embora o principal candidato do partido no Estado tenha declarado que o objetivo do AfD é governar sozinho lá, Weidel foi além, expressando confiança de que o partido conquistará a maioria necessária para governar sozinho no Estado. Uma pesquisa recente da Infratest dimap mostra a AfD com 41% de apoio, bem à frente dos 24% do Partido Democrata Cristão (CDU), do chanceler Friedrich Merz. Apesar de seu bom desempenho em algumas eleições regionais anteriores, o AfD ainda não conseguiu entrar em nenhum governo estadual ou federal, pois todos os outros grandes partidos descartaram a cooperação com ele.

item.title: Giuliano rescues Atletico as Alvarez jeered in Villarreal draw
item.description: Giuliano Simeone delivered a family rescue act in the dying moments, earning Atletico Madrid a dramatic 2-2 draw with Villarreal after his father Diego's side had been reduced to 10 men on a scorching afternoon of fan anger and frayed nerves.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Kallas
item.content:encoded: Giuliano Simeone delivered a family rescue act in the dying moments, earning Atletico Madrid a dramatic 2-2 draw with Villarreal after his father Diego's side had been reduced to 10 men on a scorching afternoon of fan anger and frayed nerves. The hosts appeared ready to melt completely after Robin Le Normand was sent off in the 76th minute for bringing down Georges Mikautadze, who converted the resulting penalty to put Villarreal ahead. But Atletico found one last burst on the counter-attack as Alex Baena released Giuliano down the right and the manager's son kept his cool, sliding a delicate finish beyond goalkeeper Luiz Junior. The match had been simmering with tension long before the late drama, with Atletico supporters turning their frustration on [USN:L4N44F0L3 TEXT:"Julian Alvarez"]. The striker was booed while warming up, jeered again when his name was announced among the substitutes and met with louder whistles when he came on in the 66th minute. A section of the crowd chanted: "Let him leave once and for all, let him leave..." after Alvarez had [USN:L6N42U18O TEXT:"revealed at the World Cup"] that he had spoken to the club about a possible transfer to "fulfil my dream", with Barcelona heavily linked in Spanish media reports. The hostility followed him beyond the final whistle as he headed straight to the changing room while teammates saluted the fans, drawing another heavy round of boos. After a flat first half, Atletico took the lead in the 59th minute through Marc Pubill, who curled a superb strike from outside the box into the top corner. Villarreal levelled seven minutes later when Morten Hjulmand conceded a penalty for a foul on Tajon Buchanan near the edge of the box, allowing Gerard Moreno to stroke his spot kick to Jan Oblak's left. VAR then intervened after Le Normand's challenge on Mikautadze, prompting the referee to award another penalty and flash the red card, before Giuliano ensured Atletico escaped with something from a feverish afternoon.

item.title: Jefferson-Wooden beats Alfred in Silesia, Seville takes men's sprint
item.description: World champion Melissa Jefferson-Wooden handed Olympic gold medallist Julien Alfred her first loss of the season to win the women's 100 metres at the Silesia Diamond League on Sunday, with Oblique Seville storming to victory in the men's sprint.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Stynes
item.content:encoded: World champion Melissa Jefferson-Wooden handed Olympic gold medallist Julien Alfred her first loss of the season to win the women's 100 metres at the Silesia Diamond League on Sunday, with Oblique Seville storming to victory in the men's sprint. In a stacked race featuring the top three at both the last Olympic Games and World Championships, American Jefferson-Wooden led from the off and posted a season's best of 10.78 seconds, with Alfred lunging in vain for the line to take second. Olympic silver medallist Sha'Carri Richardson trailed in third, at 10.96. Alfred's time of 10.83 was also her best this season, but not enough to avoid defeat for the first time over 100m and 200m this year. "Running in a race of this quality feels amazing. I missed it a lot," Alfred said. "But I am in second place, so great is not the right word, rather disappointed." World champion Seville posted a time of 9.83 seconds, and after finishing second in London last month, looks to be hitting form ahead of the World Athletics Ultimate Championships next month in Budapest. The Jamaican had time to take a look to his right at American Kenny Bednarek coming in second at 9.87, with former world champion Chris Coleman in third. Brazil's former world champion Alison Dos Santos beat world record holder Karsten Warholm to win the men's 400m hurdles in a time of 46.43 seconds. The pair were neck-and-neck coming into the home straight with Dos Santos jumping the final hurdle just in front and held off Warholm to the line, who ran 46.52. Norway's Warholm arrived in Poland on the back of retaining his European gold in Birmingham last week, which may have played a role in his tired finish. Olympic champion Marileidy Paulino left her rivals behind in the women's 400m, posting a time of 48.87 to beat Jamaican Nickisha Pryce, with Olympic silver medallist Salwa Eid Naser of Bahrain in third. Ethiopia's Tsige Duguma came from behind with a bursting sprint finish to overtake Australian Jessica Hull before the line to win the women's 1,500m. Hull looked headed for victory coming into the final 100m, before Duguma stormed past, winning with a personal best of 3:55.06. World silver medallist Dorcus Ewoi took third. HOCKER AND INGEBRIGTSEN DUEL FAILS TO MATERIALISE The men's 1,500m had been billed as the battle between Olympic champion Cole Hocker and Norway's Jakob Ingebrigtsen, who was running his first 1,500 in almost a year and only his second race this season after winning 5,000m European gold last week. The pair were left to contend for third place, with Hocker finishing ahead of Ingebrigtsen, as American Ethan Strand won in a time of 3:30.77 ahead of Kenyan Phanuel Kipkosgei Koech. UKRAINIAN PRIDE Olympic champion and world record holder Yaroslava Mahuchikh was the only athlete to clear 2.00 metres to win the women's high jump on the day her country Ukraine celebrates National Flag Day. "I like to represent Ukraine, this is really important to me considering that the war lasts already more than four years," Mahuchikh said. "Today is our day of the Ukrainian flag and this makes my victory even more special." Mondo Duplantis won the men's pole vault but failed in his bid to break the world record for a 16th time. It may not have been a Diamond League event, but with Duplantis involved, the crowd inside the sun-soaked Silesia Stadium were captivated to the end. The Swede looked rocky early on, failing his first attempts at 5.65 metres and 5.90, but was the only one to clear 6.20. The bar was raised to 6.32, with Duplantis looking to break his own record by another centimetre, but retired after failing with his first effort.

item.title: China adia a missão lunar Chang'e-7
item.description: A China anunciou neste domingo que adiou sua missão lunar Chang'e-7 após uma “avaliação abrangente”, segundo a agência de notícias estatal Xinhua.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A China anunciou neste domingo que adiou sua missão lunar Chang'e-7 após uma “avaliação abrangente”, segundo a agência de notícias estatal Xinhua. A missão não tripulada Chang’e-7 “não atende às condições para o lançamento e, portanto, não pode ser realizada dentro da janela de lançamento prevista para este ano”, informou a Xinhua, citando autoridades. A sonda espacial deveria procurar água congelada perto do polo sul da Lua.

item.title: Can Emery do it again? Player churn leaves Spaniard facing greatest Villa challenge
item.description: Unai Emery has proven time and again at his various clubs that he can deliver even after his crown jewels are sold on from under his nose but the rebuilding challenge he now faces at Aston Villa might be his biggest so far.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Unai Emery has proven time and again at his various clubs that he can deliver even after his crown jewels are sold on from under his nose but the rebuilding challenge he now faces at Aston Villa might be his biggest so far. The Spaniard watched aghast on Sunday as Europa League winners Villa were dismantled 4-0 in their Premier League opener at Brighton and Hove Albion. A surprising result on paper perhaps, but Villa fans who made the trip to the south coast might have feared the worst. Only five of the players that started the Europa League final against Freiburg on that memorable night in Istanbul in May, began the match at Brighton. England duo Morgan Rogers and Ezri Konsa have joined Chelsea and Arsenal respectively, Lucas Digne has gone to Paris St Germain and Youri Tielemans is now a Manchester United player. It could get worse too with striker Ollie Watkins left out on Sunday with his Villa future in doubt. Villa also sold some of their prime assets ahead of last season yet Emery's side still finished fourth and claimed the club's first European title for 44 years. The endless player churn has become a recurring theme of Villa's rise under Emery. Yet while previous overhauls have been absorbed without derailing progress, the scale of this summer's departures leaves far greater uncertainty over whether Villa can remain among England's elite. Not that he was complaining about the cards he has been dealt on Sunday - vowing instead to forge another team capable of challenging English soccer's elite. "We know, we had it before here. We had it in different moments. In four years we had it maybe five times in different circumstances," Emery told Sky Sports. "But we are going forward, moving always forward. My responsibility is to try to analyse, to find solutions and for the transfer window we have 10 days to find solutions, and we have then of course a way to find solutions with the players we have and we are doing that. "We always recover and came back from situations like that and I'm confident we will now." Emery also pointed to the fact that after five Premier League games last season they had three points and had scored one goal. "Hopefully this season can go the same way as that," the former Valencia, Sevilla, Paris St Germain, Arsenal and Villarreal coach, said. Emery offered a cryptic response to questions about the future of England striker Watkins when asked why he was missing from the match-day squad. "Ask him. I only can answer it by silence," he said. Things began to unravel for Villa after eight minutes when Victor Lindelof scored into his own net. Maxim De Cuyper turned in a cross by Georginio Rutter after 18 minutes before Jack Hinshelwood's quick-fire brace before halftime left Villa reeling. That was not even the worst of it as new signing Joao Gomes kicked out an opponent and was sent off. While Villa will have to dust themselves down, it was the perfect start for Brighton who have also had to contend with the loss of high-calibre players such as Jan Paul van Hecke and Danny Welbeck. "We need every player," manager Fabian Hurzeler said. "We will always get young players in full of potential, it's up to us to develop them. It was a positive start so let's keep pushing them."

item.title: Ataques aéreos israelenses em Gaza matam duas pessoas, incluindo um menino de 4 anos, segundo equipes médicas
item.description: Dois ataques aéreos israelenses na Faixa de Gaza, neste domingo, mataram pelo menos duas pessoas, incluindo um menino de 4 anos, e feriram outras sete, segundo autoridades de saúde palestinas.
item.dc:creator: Nidal Al-Mughrabi
item.content:encoded: Dois ataques aéreos israelenses na Faixa de Gaza, neste domingo, mataram pelo menos duas pessoas, incluindo um menino de 4 anos, e feriram outras sete, segundo autoridades de saúde palestinas. Um dos ataques atingiu um prédio na cidade de Zawayda, no centro do enclave, após um aviso do exército israelense para que os proprietários do imóvel deixassem a área, segundo moradores. Equipes médicas afirmaram que detritos e estilhaços espalhados por dezenas de metros ao redor feriram pelo menos seis pessoas, incluindo o menino de 4 anos, Mohammad Abdel-Salam Taha, que mais tarde foi declarado morto no hospital. “Não há cessar-fogo, não há nada”, disse Abu Ahmed, um palestino deslocado que se abrigava perto do prédio, que o ataque aéreo reduziu a uma pilha de aço e concreto retorcidos. “Queremos soluções, queremos viver em paz”, disse ele. O segundo ataque aéreo ocorreu no campo de refugiados de Nuseirat, nas proximidades, segundo autoridades de saúde. As Forças Armadas de Israel afirmaram que estavam investigando ambos os ataques. ISRAEL ATACA O HAMAS APESAR DO CESSAR-FOGO Um cessar-fogo de outubro de 2025, apoiado pelos Estados Unidos, interrompeu os principais combates no território devastado, mas não conseguiu pôr fim aos ataques das forças armadas israelenses, que afirmaram ter como objetivo impedir ataques do Hamas e de outros militantes de Gaza. As forças armadas afirmaram em um comunicado no final do sábado que haviam atacado e matado um militante de alto escalão do Hamas, Sharif Al-Hasnat, na cidade de Deir Al-Balah. Segundo elas, ele liderava os esforços para restaurar a “infraestrutura subterrânea” do Hamas. O Hamas acusa Israel de violar o cessar-fogo e de minar os esforços para implementar um plano mais amplo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, para pôr fim ao conflito em Gaza, que também inclui a retirada israelense e o desarmamento do Hamas. Mais de 1.280 palestinos foram mortos em Gaza desde que o cessar-fogo entrou em vigor em outubro passado, segundo autoridades de saúde de Gaza, enquanto as forças armadas israelenses afirmam que quatro soldados israelenses foram mortos.

item.title: Onze corpos foram recuperados após naufrágio de um barco que transportava migrantes na costa da Tunísia
item.description: Onze corpos foram recuperados pela guarda costeira da Tunísia após o naufrágio, no fim de semana, de um barco que transportava migrantes tunisianos a caminho da Itália; outras três pessoas continuam desaparecidas, informou a Guarda Nacional neste domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Onze corpos foram recuperados pela guarda costeira da Tunísia após o naufrágio, no fim de semana, de um barco que transportava migrantes tunisianos a caminho da Itália; outras três pessoas continuam desaparecidas, informou a Guarda Nacional neste domingo. Equipes da guarda costeira, das forças armadas e da proteção civil, apoiadas por dois helicópteros, continuaram as buscas pelos desaparecidos. O barco, que partiu na madrugada de quinta-feira com 15 pessoas a bordo, em sua maioria jovens, naufragou na costa tunisiana e, até o momento, apenas uma pessoa foi resgatada com vida, informou no sábado o líder de um grupo de defesa dos direitos dos migrantes. O homem que sobreviveu disse que ficou à deriva no mar por 48 horas antes de ser resgatado por uma embarcação comercial. Entre os que estavam a bordo estavam sete membros da mesma família e um homem com sua esposa grávida, informou o chefe do Observatório Tunisiano dos Direitos Humanos à Reuters. Todos os migrantes eram da região de Ben Guerdane, no sudeste da Tunísia, e dezenas de jovens se reuniram no final da noite de sábado na cidade próxima à fronteira com a Líbia para exigir que as operações de busca fossem aceleradas. A polícia disparou gás lacrimogêneo para dispersar os manifestantes. A rota do Mediterrâneo Central, partindo da costa norte-africana, é uma das rotas migratórias mais mortíferas do mundo, utilizada por migrantes da África e do Oriente Médio que buscam chegar à Europa, muitas vezes em embarcações superlotadas ou impróprias para navegar. A Human Rights Watch, a Anistia Internacional e dezenas de outras organizações de direitos humanos e humanitárias afirmaram em um comunicado no mês passado que um acordo migratório entre a Tunísia e a União Europeia havia estimulado e normalizado graves abusos contra migrantes e requerentes de asilo na Tunísia. As organizações instaram a UE a suspender o financiamento de atividades relacionadas à migração e ao controle de fronteiras que envolvam as forças de segurança tunisianas.
